scientific_boundary: Internal causal mediation only; direct endpoint is near chance and is never used as a causal readout.
layer_selection: Inherited frozen shared/interaction layers 5/16; downstream readout layers 16/24/31 fixed before internal inference.
fit_scope: A/B/C directions and downstream purpose/format projection directions fit on training purpose families within each held-out-family fold.
strength: unit raw direction; alpha equals one training-block projection standard deviation for the selected component
readouts: Projection scores onto training-derived downstream A (purpose) and B (format) directions; report AUC and signed target margin by held-out family. No candidate-token logits or generation.

forward.token_position: last real prompt token after left padding
